arxiv-1912-07617.title: 2D Fermion on the Strip with Boundary Defects as a CFT with Excited Spin Fields
arxiv-1912-07617.creator: Riccardo Finotello, Igor Pesando
arxiv-1912-07617.description: Abstract We consider a two-dimensional fermion on the strip in the presence of an arbitrary number of zero-dimensional boundary changing defects. We show that the theory is still conformal with time dependent stress-energy tensor and that the allowed defects can be understood as excited spin fields. Finally we compute correlation functions involving these excited spin fields without using bosonization.

arxiv-2007-03750.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and its Neuroscientific Implications
arxiv-2007-03750.creator: Matthew Botvinick, Jane X. Wang, Will Dabney, Kevin J. Miller, Zeb Kurth-Nelson
arxiv-2007-03750.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Matthew Botvinick, Jane X. Wang, Will Dabney, Kevin J. Miller, Zeb Kurth-Nelson. The emergence of powerful artificial intelligence is defining new research directions in neuroscience. To date, this research has focused largely on deep neural networks trained using supervised learning, in tasks such as image classification. However, there is another area of recent AI work which has so far received less attention from neuroscientists, but which may have profound neuroscientific implications: deep reinforcement learning.

arxiv-2103-10416.title: Anyons and the Double Copy
arxiv-2103-10416.creator: Daniel J Burger, William T. Emond, and Nathan Moynihan
arxiv-2103-10416.description: Abstract We examine the double copy structure of anyons in gauge theory and gravity. Using on-shell amplitude techniques, we construct little group covariant spinor-helicity variables describing massive particles with spin, which together with locality and unitarity enables us to derive the long-range tree-level scattering amplitudes involving anyons.

arxiv-2105-05746.title: Trapping enhanced by noise in nonhyperbolic and hyperbolic chaotic scattering
arxiv-2105-05746.creator: Alexandre R. Nieto, Jesús M. Seoane, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán
arxiv-2105-05746.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alexandre R. Nieto, Jesús M. Seoane, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán. The noise-enhanced trapping is a surprising phenomenon that has already been studied in chaotic scattering problems where the noise affects the physical variables but not the parameters of the system. Following this research, in this work we provide strong numerical evidence to show that an additional mechanism that enhances the trapping arises when the noise influences the energy of the system.

arxiv-2110-01469.title: Data-driven Identification of Nonlinear Power System Dynamics Using Output-only Measurements
arxiv-2110-01469.creator: Pranav Sharma, Student Member, IEEE, Venkataramana Ajjarapu, Fellow, IEEE, and Umesh Vaidya, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2110-01469.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel approach for the data-driven characterization of power system dynamics. The developed method of Extended Subspace Identification (ESI) is suitable for systems with output measurements when all the dynamics states are not observable. It is particularly applicable for power systems dynamic identification using Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) measurements.

arxiv-2212-09583.title: Photo-induced charge dynamics in 1 T T -TaS 2
arxiv-2212-09583.creator: Francesco Petocchi, Jiyu Chen, Jiajun Li, Martin Eckstein, Philipp Werner
arxiv-2212-09583.description: Abstract Recent theoretical studies showed that the electronic structure of 1 T T -TaS 2 in the low-temperature commensurate charge density wave phase exhibits a nontrivial interplay between band-insulating and Mott insulating behavior. This has important implications for the interpretation of photo-doping experiments.

arxiv-2303-02619.title: Generalized Hausdorff metric on S b \displaystyle S_{b} -metric space and some fixed point results
arxiv-2303-02619.creator: Jayanta Sarkar, Megha Pandey, Tanmoy Som, B.S.Choudhury
arxiv-2303-02619.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jayanta Sarkar, Megha Pandey, Tanmoy Som, B.S.Choudhury. In this paper, a metric on S b \displaystyle S_{b} -metric space analogous to the Hausdorff metric has been introduced and some basic properties are obtained on multi-valued S b \displaystyle S_{b} -metric space. Further, the fundamental multi-valued contraction of Nadler(1962) has been extended to the S b \displaystyle S_{b} -metric space setting, and two results have been established. The entire study is supported by suitable examples.

arxiv-2309-12195.title: Intentional binding enhances hybrid BCI control
arxiv-2309-12195.creator: Tristan Venot
arxiv-2309-12195.description: Abstract Abstract Mental imagery-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) allow to interact with the external environment by naturally bypassing the musculoskeletal system. Making BCIs efficient and accurate is paramount to improve the reliability of real-life and clinical applications, from open-loop device control to closed-loop neurorehabilitation.

arxiv-2401-07921.creator: GRAVITY Collaboration(): R. Garcia Lopez, A. Natta, R. Fedriani, A. Caratti o Garatti, J. Sanchez-Bermudez, K. Perraut, C. Dougados, Y.-I. Bouarour, J. Bouvier, W. arxiv-2401-07921.description: Abstract Context. The region of protoplanetary disks closest to a star (within 1-2 au) is shaped by a number of different processes, from accretion of the disk material onto the central star to ejection in the form of winds and jets.

arxiv-2401-12835.title: SGTR+: End-to-end Scene Graph Generation with Transformer
arxiv-2401-12835.creator: Rongjie Li, Songyang Zhang, and Xuming He
arxiv-2401-12835.description: Abstract Scene Graph Generation (SGG) remains a challenging visual understanding task due to its compositional property. Most previous works adopt a bottom-up, two-stage or point-based, one-stage approach, which often suffers from high time complexity or suboptimal designs. In this work, we propose a novel SGG method to address the aforementioned issues, formulating the task as a bipartite graph construction problem.

arxiv-2412-11584.title: Charmful two-body Ω b \Omega_{b} decays in the light-front quark model
arxiv-2412-11584.creator: Yan-Li Wang, Yu-Kuo Hsiao, Kai-Lei Wang, Chong-Chung Lih
arxiv-2412-11584.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yan-Li Wang, Yu-Kuo Hsiao, Kai-Lei Wang, Chong-Chung Lih. We investigate the singly and doubly charmful two-body Ω b − \Omega_{b}^{-} decays using the light-front quark model. Our findings reveal that most branching fractions calculated in this study, such as ℬ ( Ω b − → Ξ − D 0 , Ξ − D ∗ 0 ) {\cal B}(\Omega_{b}^{-}\to\Xi^{-}D^{0},\Xi^{-}D^{*0}) , can be ten to one hundred times larger than those reported in previous calculations.

arxiv-2510-04974.title: StructuralDecompose: A Modular Framework for Robust Time Series Decomposition in R
arxiv-2510-04974.creator: Allen Daniel Sunny
arxiv-2510-04974.description: Abstract We present StructuralDecompose , an R package for modular and interpretable time series decomposition. Unlike existing approaches that treat decomposition as a monolithic process, StructuralDecompose separates the analysis into distinct components: changepoint detection, anomaly detection, smoothing, and decomposition. This design provides flexibility and robustness, allowing users to tailor methods to specific time series characteristics.

pmc-10626826.title: Cohort profile: recruitment and retention in a prospective cohort of Canadian healthcare workers during the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-10626826.creator: Nicola Cherry, Anil Adisesh, Igor Burstyn, Quentin Durand-Moreau, Jean-Michel Galarneau, France Labrèche, Shannon M Ruzycki, Tanis Zadunayski
pmc-10626826.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). PurposeHealthcare workers were recruited early in 2020 to chart effects on their health as the COVID-19 pandemic evolved. The aim was to identify modifiable workplace risk factors for infection and mental ill health.ParticipantsParticipants were recruited from four Canadian provinces, physicians (medical doctors, MDs) in Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec, registered nurses (RNs), licensed practical nurses (LPNs) and healthcare aides (HCAs) in Alberta and personal support workers (PSWs) in Ontario. Volunteers gave blood for serology testing before and after vaccination.

pmc-10667717.title: Sulfur nanocomposites with insecticidal effect for the control of Bactericera cockerelli
pmc-10667717.creator: Lany S Araujo-Yépez, Juan O Tigrero-Salas, Vicente A Delgado-Rodríguez, Vladimir A Aguirre-Yela, Josué N Villota-Méndez
pmc-10667717.description: The purpose of this research was to synthesize nanocomposites consisting of sulfur nanoparticles coated with eucalyptus and rosemary essential oils to determine the insecticidal effect in the control of nymphs of paratrioza (Bactericera cockerelli (Sulc) (Hemiptera: Triozidae)) in potato crops.

pmc-11548651.title: Inverse-Designed Ultra-Compact Passive Phase Shifters for High-Performance Beam Steering
pmc-11548651.creator: Tianyang Fu, Mengfan Chu, Ke Jin, Honghan Sha, Xin Yan, Xueguang Yuan, Yang’an Zhang, Jinnan Zhang, Xia Zhang, Sung Min Park
pmc-11548651.description: Ultra-compact passive phase shifters are inversely designed by the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm. The wavelength-dependent phase difference between two output beams originates from the different distances of the input light passing through the 4 μm × 3.2 μm rectangular waveguide with random-distributed air-hole arrays.

pmc-12608990.title: Population-Level Analysis of Personalized Food Recommendation Using Reinforcement Learning
pmc-12608990.creator: Yone Tellechea, Markel Arrojo, Ander Cejudo, Cristina Martin, Zhengjun Qiu
pmc-12608990.description: This paper introduces an innovative methodology for optimizing recommendation strategies across different populations within the food industry. While previous approaches to recommending courses have overlooked cultural and age-based preferences, our work demonstrates how understanding these differences can significantly enhance the attractiveness for consumers and create new opportunities for marketing.

pmc-12794523.title: The Genetic Landscape of Familial Hypercholesterolemia in Telangana, Southern India: Novel Mutations and Clinical Implications
pmc-12794523.creator: Supriya Garapati, Sakthivadivel Varatharajan, Ariyanachi K, Kishore Yadav, Rohit Saluja, Sailu Yellaboina
pmc-12794523.description: Background: Familial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is a genetic disorder characterized by elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) levels, leading to premature cardiovascular disease (CVD). This study aimed to identify genetic variants associated with FH in patients from Telangana State, India.Methods: Probands with suspected FH were identified using the Dutch Lipid Clinic Network (DLCN) score, followed by cascade screening of their first-degree relatives.

pmc-13037832.title: MMP9 regulates osteogenesis and MMP2 expression through the TGF-β1/SMAD2/3 signaling pathway in lipopolysaccharide-induced osteoblasts
pmc-13037832.creator: Lei Li, Yang Yang, Ximei Lu, Hui Li
pmc-13037832.description: Matrix metalloproteinases (MMP) act as effectors and regulators in normal growth and development as well as in pathological processes. The gelatinases MMP2 and MMP9 exhibit similar structures and biological reactions. The purpose of this study was to clarify the relationship between MMP9 and MMP2 in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced osteoblasts.

pmc-13069758.title: Scaling up an integrated primary mental health screening programme in South Africa through co-development and continuous quality improvement
pmc-13069758.creator: André J van Rensburg, Zamasomi Luvuno, Tasneem Kathree, Nikiwe Hongo, Londiwe Mthethwa, Merridy Grant, Arvin Bhana, Deepa Rao, Inge Petersen
pmc-13069758.description: BackgroundDespite global progress in developing integrated mental healthcare on primary healthcare level, particularly in low-and-middle income countries, descriptions of scaling-up efforts remain scarce. The aim of this study was two-fold. First, to describe a collaborative approach to embed a common mental health conditions screening tool and process within district primary health care systems in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

pmc-13254882.title: Quantifying Extensor Tendon and Articular Surface Involvement During Phalangeal Intramedullary Fixation
pmc-13254882.creator: Julie Mekhail, Rhiana Rivas, Nikalus Skipp, Isabella Trancoso, Deana Mercer
pmc-13254882.description: PurposePhalangeal fractures of the hand are the second most common upper-extremity fracture in the United States with a fracture incidence of 130/100,000 persons. Numerous studies have reported on the biomechanical efficacy of intramedullary (IM) hand nail fixation of the phalanges, and the large volume of literature indicates the recent increased utilization of IM hand nails.

pmc-13408526.title: Non-Targeted Metabolomics Reveals the Metabolic Differentiation of Rice from Adjacent Small-Scale Producing Areas and Its Response to Climatic and Soil Factors
pmc-13408526.creator: Xianxin Wu, Zeting Li, Tianshu Peng, Lina Li, Qiujun Lin, Guang Li, Chunjing Guo, Qingchuan Liu, Jianzhong Wang
pmc-13408526.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Geographical traceability of rice is critical for authenticity identification and quality control, yet it poses considerable challenges for tracing origins in adjacent small-scale producing areas. To explore the causes of metabolic differences and geographical traceability potential of rice from adjacent small-scale producing areas, non-targeted metabolomics combined with multivariate statistical analysis was employed to systematically investigate the metabolic profiles of rice from Panjin (PJ), Donggang (DG) and Yingkou (YK) in Liaoning Province.

pmc-13476431.title: Mapping the generative era: a bibliometric and specialty-focused analysis of large language models in healthcare
pmc-13476431.creator: Jianding Peng, Yao Tuo, Gang Wang, Ruiqin Han, Qing Wang, Yi Wang, Zixin Hu, Xiaofei Hu
pmc-13476431.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Large language models (LLMs) have been rapidly adopted in healthcare since 2022; however, field-level trends and specialty differences remain poorly characterized. This study aims to map the research landscape of LLMs in healthcare and generate comparative specialty profiles through a bibliometric analysis using the Web of Science Core Collection (2015–2025), including English-language articles and reviews analyzed for publication and citation trends, leading countries, institutions, authors, journals, co-citation networks, and keyword structures with VOSviewer and CiteSpace, with sub-analyses for medicine, general and internal;

pmc-13558890.title: Global longitudinal strain and left ventricular ejection fraction for early detection of chemotherapy-related cardiac dysfunction in breast cancer: A prospective comparison of doxorubicin-based and paclitaxel– carboplatin regimens
pmc-13558890.creator: Rizka Faradilla, Teuku Heriansyah, Novita Novita, Haris Munirwan, Maha Fitra
pmc-13558890.description: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is widely used in routine practice to assess cardiotoxicity; however, reductions in LVEF often reflect relatively advanced myocardial damage. Global longitudinal strain (GLS) quantifies myocardial deformation and has demonstrated greater sensitivity for identifying early systolic dysfunction, yet comparative evidence on myocardial strain changes between doxorubicin-based regimens and non-anthracycline chemotherapy in breast cancer patients remains limited.

pmc-13574360.title: Functional Analysis and Quality Assessment of Mobile Applications for Managing Alcohol Use Disorder
pmc-13574360.creator: Yangmi Lee, Ji-Min Seo
pmc-13574360.description: Aims:This study investigated the current mobile applications (apps) for the management of alcohol use disorder (AUD) and analyzed their functionality and quality.Design/Methods:A comprehensive search of the Apple App Store and Google Play Store was conducted between August 1 and October 31, 2023, based on predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, to identify apps specifically designed for patients with AUD.
